subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Crisis Response and Recovery
description: Learn Crisis Response and Recovery in one minute.

hook.text: When crisis hits, central banks have one tool: flood the system with money. It works until it creates the next crisis.

buildup.text: Crisis response typically combines interest rate cuts, quantitative easing, and fiscal stimulus to prevent collapse.

discovery.text: The 2020 COVID response injected $16 trillion globally. It prevented depression but fueled inflation by 2022.

twist.text: Each crisis response creates seeds of the next one. Low rates fuel bubbles. Stimulus fuels inflation.

climax.text: Crisis management is about choosing the least bad option. Every rescue has costs that appear later.

punchline.text: $16 trillion injected. Depression prevented. Inflation arrived next.

quiz.question: What unintended consequence did the 2020 COVID stimulus create?
